Chinese Tech Executives May Join Xi's US Visit, Sources Say

Executives from Chinese companies BYD, CATL, and Xiaomi are reportedly being considered to join President Xi Jinping's potential visit to the United States. The inclusion of these business leaders is suggested by sources familiar with the matter. The specific companies mentioned are involved in the automotive and battery technology sectors, as well as consumer electronics.
